# Generated by execspec. DO NOT EDIT.

Everything in this directory is generated from the specification IR.
Hand edits are overwritten on the next regeneration.

## Workflow

1. Change the specification module, then compile it:
   `execspec compile --module <spec>/dist/spec.js --out build/<name>.execspec.json`
2. Regenerate this directory:
   `execspec generate typescript --ir build/<name>.execspec.json --out <this directory>`
   (from an execspec clone: `node packages/cli/dist/index.js ...`)
3. Rebuild the host and run conformance:
   `execspec test --ir build/<name>.execspec.json --host <host executable>`
   Regeneration is deterministic: `git diff` after regenerating must be empty.

## Rules

- The specification digest is embedded in the dispatcher. A conformance
  handshake failure saying "digest mismatch" means stale generated code
  or a stale host build — regenerate and rebuild.
- Business logic belongs in the handwritten implementation target, never
  here. Implementations depend only on the generated types and protocol.
- Domain failures are union values in operation outputs; `throws` is for
  genuine implementation defects only.
- TypeScript note: optional fields are absent keys — never assigned
  `null` or `undefined`.
